layout.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8 or p-12 for sections. gap-8 for grids.
layout.cards: Square or very slightly rounded (max rounded-sm). bg-white, 1px border border-slate-200, thick top border (border-t-4 border-[#e10600]).
layout.general: Mobile-first approach. Ensure columns collapse to 1 on mobile.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use sharp borders. Thick red accents for active states, tabs, or premium elements.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. shadow-sm default, shadow-md on hover. Avoid muddy large shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean solids. No gradients, no glassmorphism.

motion.hover: Snappy. transition-transform duration-200. Hover on cards: -translate-y-1 shadow-lg.
motion.buttons: transition-colors duration-200. Color fill on hover. Red to darker red.

components.button_primary: bg-[#e10600] text-white rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-[#b80500] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#e10600] focus:ring-offset-2 transition-colors
components.button_secondary: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-slate-800 transition-colors
components.badges: bg-slate-900 text-white px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider, or bg-[#e10600] for VIP/Hot tickets.
components.navbar: bg-slate-950 text-white sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-slate-800 py-4

media.style: High contrast, high saturation images. No vintage filters. Professional sports photography.

images.description: F1 race car speeding down track

instructions_to_main_agent: CLEANUP FIRST: Delete or comment out conflicting CSS rules in App.css and index.css that enforce random purple/cyan/orange/yellow colors or broken dark themes. Apply standard Tailwind classes instead.
COLOR ENFORCEMENT: Strictly prohibit the use of tailwind colors: purple, violet, fuchsia, pink, orange, yellow, cyan, teal. If they exist in the codebase, replace them with slate or red.

THEME: Implement a light theme for the main content area (bg-slate-50 or white) so the event cards pop. Use a dark theme (bg-slate-950) for the Navbar and Footer to frame the site and give a premium feel.
CARDS: Event cards must be 'bg-white', 'text-slate-900', with a sharp 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm' border. Add 'border-t-4 border-[#e10600]' to make them look like premium Formula 1 UI.
TYPOGRAPHY: Import and use 'Oswald' font for all headings to give it that aggressive, sporty, premium look. Use 'Inter' for body.
DATA TEST IDs: Ensure all buttons, links, and cards have explicit 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., 'data-testid="buy-ticket-button"').
NO GLASSMORPHISM: The prompt explicitly asks for bold, clean, high-contrast. Remove any 'backdrop-blur' or dark glass elements fighting the light theme.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grid/flex with optical alignment.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles, in this case sharp, high-contrast block buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
